blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08. Native xDAI balances and the WETH-style WXDAI wrapper expose no local issuer blacklist, freeze, pause, or arbitrary seizure path. The canonical bridge backing is approximately 99% sUSDS plus liquid USDS, however, and those tracked Sky assets carry possible/direct freeze reach. A Sky-side freeze can impair the bridge escrow and xDAI exit path, so the resolved posture is Upstream rather than No even though existing native balances are not directly blacklistable.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: xDAI is a native Gnosis gas balance, not an ERC-20 deployment. Ethereum USDS is escrowed in the Foreign Bridge and relayed through the BridgeRouter; a 4-of-7 validator network authorizes the Home Bridge to credit native xDAI through BlockReward, while the reverse path burns xDAI against the bridge's minted-minus-burned accounting before USDS is released. The route is externally validated and governance-administered: current Ethereum and Gnosis bridge limits are explicit, both validator-management contracts are 4-of-7, chain-local 8-of-15 Safes control bridge administration and proxy upgrades, and no contract-enforced timelock was observed. WXDAI remains only a same-chain traded wrapper and is excluded from canonical supply matching.
